label: Religious freedom returns and the church is backed from the White House
description: Religious freedom coming to the American people and a backing of the church from the president unlike anything seen in this generation, with the Bible and prayer named, favour given to Christians in his presidency, and a Great Awakening coming to America and Europe.
aliases: I saw religious freedom coming to American people

label: Twenty days of prayer for a man to have a radical visitation
description: An instruction to pray for twenty days over a man he describes only as wearing satanic clothes, with the expectation that at the end of those twenty days a major turn of events comes in that man's life and he has a radical visitation from Jesus. Given 10 November 2024.
aliases: pray over that for the next 20 days

label: Celebrities leave America to escape prosecution
description: Celebrities associated with the sex trafficking case around Diddy trying to leave America secretly to avoid prosecution, with an exposing of hidden and embarrassing things coming for some of them.
aliases: they will try to escape America

label: Two visions at once: what was tried and what God does instead
description: He describes seeing two separate futures in the same sitting, a fork in the road: on one side New York, the virus and what the enemy was trying to bring about, and on the other the blessing and the covering that come through the alliance with Israel. He says his job is never to bring confusion.
aliases: what it's tried to be and what the Lord wants
